summary.text: Clay Staires is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 66 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Clay Staires was born in Wichita, Kansas, and lives in Skiatook, Oklahoma.
He graduated from Skiatook High School and earned a degree in education from the University of Oklahoma.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as operating Shepherd's Ford Ranch and working as a teacher and coach, and it says he founded The Leadership Initiative.
He took office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Jadine Nollan, and Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Administrative Rules Committee.
Kenneth Blevins, a Libertarian, is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
